action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
USN-8733-1 fixed vulnerabilities in Gzip. This update provides the
corresponding fix for Gzip on Ubuntu 14.04 LTS, Ubuntu 18.04 LTS and Ubuntu
20.04 LTS.

Original advisory details:

 Michał Majchrowicz and Marcin Wyczechowski discovered that Gzip's gzexe
utility created temporary files in an insecure manner when mktemp was
unavailable. A local attacker could possibly use this issue to overwrite
arbitrary files. (CVE-2026-41991)

 Elias Hasas, Michał Majchrowicz and Marcin Wyczechowski discovered that
Gzip incorrectly handled certain compressed files. An attacker could
possibly use this issue to obtain sensitive information or cause Gzip to
crash, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2026-41992)
isummary: Several security issues were fixed in Gzip.
title: Gzip vulnerabilities
